locator: Table / Misaligned AI systems / Mitigations-industry-wide / bullet 4
context_stem: Row: Misaligned AI systems in high-stakes settings. Lead-in: As risk becomes harder to rule out, this case will likely include some combination of:
excerpt: Evidence that AI models lack the propensity to deceive, manipulate, or sabotage users.
paraphrase: Recommendation: evidence that models lack deceptive, manipulative, or sabotaging propensities.

context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Capability or usage threshold.
excerpt: AI systems that can fully automate, or otherwise dramatically accelerate, the work of large, top-tier teams of human researchers in domains where fast progress could cause threats to international security and/or rapid disruptions to the global balance of power—for example, energy, robotics, weapons development, and AI itself.
paraphrase: The threshold covers AI that can fully automate or dramatically accelerate top-tier research teams in domains threatening international security or global power balance.

context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Capability or usage threshold.
excerpt: For now, our evaluations will focus specifically on AI R&D, as this domain likely plays to AI systems' current strengths and is more tractable to assess than capabilities in other domains.
paraphrase: Evaluations currently focus on AI R&D since it suits current AI strengths and is more tractable to assess.

context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Capability or usage threshold.
excerpt: Additionally, AI R&D alone could cause acceleration in AI capabilities improvements, to the point where all of the threats listed above (and more) develop very quickly.
paraphrase: AI R&D automation alone could accelerate capabilities so much that all other listed threats develop rapidly.

context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Capability or usage threshold.
excerpt: We will consider this threshold to be met if we determine that either (1) our models would be able to fully substitute for our entire set of Research Scientists and Research Engineers, at competitive costs (i.e., within a factor of 5); or (2) there is "dramatic acceleration" of the pace of AI progress for reasons that likely relate to the automation of AI R&D.
paraphrase: The threshold is met if models could fully substitute for all Research Scientists/Engineers at within 5x cost, or if dramatic AI-progress acceleration occurs due to AI R&D automation.

context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Capability or usage threshold.
excerpt: We would consider scenario (2) to have occurred where (a) we observe or expect double the rate of progress in AI aggregate capabilities compared to both the rate we'd expect and the fastest rate of extended progress we've observed in the absence of significant AI contributions to AI R&D and (b) it is plausible that this doubling is substantially attributable to the automation of research and/or engineering.
paraphrase: Scenario 2 is met when observed/expected progress doubles relative to baseline expectations and historical rates without AI contribution, and this doubling is plausibly due to automation of research/engineering.

context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Capability or usage threshold.
excerpt: (as opposed to other factors, such as increased headcount, compute, or general productivity), such that continuation of the trend in AI progress seems likely to lead to even greater acceleration.
paraphrase: The doubling must not be attributable to other factors like headcount or compute increases, and should suggest a trend toward even greater acceleration.

context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Capability or usage threshold.
excerpt: This capability threshold is intended to reflect our definition of highly capable models (see Section 3.6).
paraphrase: This threshold reflects the definition of highly capable models detailed in Section 3.6.

context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Capability or usage threshold.
excerpt: It may be sensible to add earlier, and/or easier-to-measure, thresholds that trigger less demanding versions of the mitigations for this threshold.
paraphrase: It may be worth adding earlier or more measurable thresholds triggering lighter mitigation versions.

locator: Table / Automated R&D / Mitigations-our plan / lead-in
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Mitigations—our plan as a company.
paraphrase: This introduces a list of company commitments for the Automated R&D threshold.

locator: Table / Automated R&D / Mitigations-our plan / bullet 1
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Lead-in: We will:
excerpt: Resource and complete significant "moonshot R&D for security" projects, to explore ambitious and possibly unconventional ways to achieve unprecedented levels of security against the world's best-resourced attackers.
paraphrase: Commitment to resource and complete ambitious 'moonshot' security R&D projects to reach unprecedented security levels against top attackers.

locator: Table / Automated R&D / Mitigations-our plan / bullet 2-a
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Lead-in: We will:
excerpt: Achieve an "eyes on everything" state for our internal AI development.
paraphrase: Commitment to achieve full visibility ('eyes on everything') over internal AI development.

locator: Table / Automated R&D / Mitigations-our plan / bullet 2-b
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Lead-in: We will:
excerpt: We will comprehensively gather, centralize, and maintain logs for all critical AI-development activities, and use AI to analyze them for issues including security threats, concerning behavior by insiders (humans as well as AI systems themselves), and training processes or data that are out of line with the public Constitution that shapes and defines our AI models.
paraphrase: Commitment to comprehensively log critical AI-development activities and use AI to analyze logs for security threats, insider concerns, and Constitution misalignment.

locator: Table / Automated R&D / Mitigations-our plan / bullet 3
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Lead-in: We will:
excerpt: Perform systematic alignment assessments to examine Claude's behavioral patterns and propensities, meaningfully incorporating mechanistic interpretability and adversarial red-teaming to test our auditing methods.
paraphrase: Commitment to systematic alignment assessments of Claude's behavior using mechanistic interpretability and adversarial red-teaming.

locator: Table / Automated R&D / Mitigations-our plan / bullet 4
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Lead-in: We will:
excerpt: Develop our internal red-teaming of our deployment safeguards to the point where our internal red-teaming performs better at finding potential jailbreaks than the collective abilities of the participants in our established bug bounty programs.
paraphrase: Commitment to develop internal red-teaming until it outperforms the collective bug-bounty participant community at finding jailbreaks.
